text:
anna-docs: FYI opened PR updating glacier4b model card — adds seq limits, quant compat notes, and new bench numbers. PR: https://git.redwood/example/pr/1234
sam-ml: thanks! quick q: bench runner used 2x A100 80GB? numbers look high
anna-docs: used 4x A100-40GB mixed precision, batch=8, seq=2048. I'll add hardware notes.
leo-runtime: streaming is supported on v2 runtime, but we need to mention kv-cache warmup for long-context; also note fallback to quant-llama7b when OOM
maya-devex: SDK snippets updated in the PR — need a python example for Client2.0. Proposed:
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.generate(model='glacier4b', prompt='Summarize the release notes', max_tokens=200)
print(resp.text)
```
sam-ml: add quantized model profile: int8+PTQ passed local tests, but watch tokenization differences for emojis and mixed scripts
anna-docs: I'll add a "compatibility" section listing tokenizer caveats and recommend tokenizer v0.5.2 or later
leo-runtime: also add throughput numbers for hosted vs dedicated and call out warmup latency (p50/p95). For example: p50=80ms/token, p95=240ms/token on dedicated-4xA100-40GB with batch=8
maya-devex: I left TODO to fix link to benchmark CSV — currently pointing at old bucket. @deploy-bot can you re-upload to assets?
deploy-bot: uploaded glacier4b-bench-202311.csv -> gs://redwood-assets/glacier4b/bench-202311.csv :thumbsup:
anna-docs: thanks! can someone quick review for wording? @sam-ml @leo-runtime
sam-ml: LGTM apart from minor phrasing on CPU fallback; suggest: "CPU fallback available for quantized models but with reduced throughput and tokenization differences"
leo-runtime: LGTM, leave a note about sequence truncation behavior (we truncate older KV entries; not incremental summarization)
maya-devex: will add final SDK snippet with streaming example and a JS/ts example next
anna-docs: merging after small edits, target publish Thursday EOD. cc: @product
product: noted, will include in next catalog announcement if merged
sam-ml: one more nit: change "supports 65k tokens" to "supports up to 65k tokens (condition: kv-cache enabled and model pinned to dedicated runtime)"
anna-docs: done
maya-devex: snippets updated and tested in SDK playground (py + ts)
anna-docs: merged — thanks all :rocket:
